objections.title: The mechanics do not preserve the DR-106/109/113 candidate's mandatory per-row severability
objections.finding: D-100 clauses 2 and 5 define one later owner-recording entry by candidate and authorize it to record the candidate for `those roles`. The eligibility table's single DR-106/109/113 candidate row then supplies all three rows' distinct owner sets. Nothing requires that later act to select exactly one of DR-106, DR-109, or DR-113, or says that recording/overturning one leaves the other two untouched. The pinned candidate's operative contract says the opposite: it is only a shared draft for later per-row recordings, a later D-000 entry must name which row it records, and the condition-2 effect is for the named row only. Pinning the candidate digest does not cure D-100's broader affirmative `may do` rule; the mechanics must carry this granularity expressly so they cannot be cited to bundle the three dispositions.
evidence: D-100 lines 34-51 define `one later owner-recording entry` around one of five candidate artifacts, not around a named row within a shared artifact.
D-100 lines 56-62 place DR-106, DR-109, and DR-113 and all three distinct role sets in one candidate-table row.
D-100 lines 87-89 authorize the later act to `Record the candidate ... for those roles`, with no per-row severability restriction.

deferral.DR-106-109-113.preview.v2.json line 15 says adopting or overturning one row does not adopt or overturn the others and that a later D-000 entry must name which row it records; line 16 calls it a shared draft for later per-row recordings; line 36 limits effect to the named row only.
The candidate remains at D-096's exact recorded sha256 194b01fc6bd9201ebdeee71b83846cff09417d7521464bd81a0fbe2aabf7502c, so that severability term is live rather than historical or inferred.
objections.impact: A later owner entry could cite D-100 to owner-record all three rows in one cycle/commit, or make overturn of one appear to affect all three, despite their different owner sets and the accepted candidate's explicit independent adoption and rollback semantics. That exceeds the exact disposition D-096 recorded and weakens decision-granular review and reversibility.
objections.requiredRepair: Add an explicit special rule for deferral.DR-106-109-113.preview.v2.json: each owner-recording entry must name exactly one of DR-106, DR-109, or DR-113; the applicable D-096 (A) grant must cover every named role for that selected row; each selected row gets its own D-000 cycle and commit; and recording, superseding, or overturning one row does not record, supersede, or overturn either other row. Align clauses 2, 3, 4, and 5 with that rule while retaining the same five-artifact eligibility boundary. Refreeze the repaired subject for turn 2.
